payload.posture: Read Colossians 4:1–6 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states prayer asks for an open door and wise speech. Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven. Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
